kamloops.title: Summerland residents return to neighbourhoods forever changed by the Bald Range wildfire
kamloops.description: For many Summerland residents returning home after the Bald Range wildfire, the relief of getting back to their community is being met with a difficult new reality

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 18
kamloops.description: Thousands of Summerland residents were given the go-ahead to return home on Tuesday as the district lifted the majority of evacuation orders related to the Bald Range fire.

kamloops.title: Evacuation order lifted for majority of Summerland, with about 150 structures believed damaged
kamloops.description: Thousands of Summerland residents are allowed to make their way home Tuesday, more than a week after the Bald Range wildfire forced them to flee.

prince-george.title: B.C. gang unit plans deployment to Fort St. John after 3 targeted shootings leave 4 injured
prince-george.description: City officials in Fort St. John, B.C., have called for more police resources after four people were hurt in three targeted shootings near local schools since July 22.

northwest.title: 3 major outages renew concerns about northwest B.C.'s communications network
northwest.description: Three large-scale telecommunications outages since May have exposed vulnerabilities in northwest B.C.'s communications network. Politicians are calling for tougher penalties for copper theft and greater network redundancy, warning repeated disruptions could put businesses, health-care services and emergency response at risk.
